description: Synthetic fixture for the stub-transport endpoint tests (tests/test_endpoint.py, tests/test_agent_loop.py). It is NOT ground truth for any real clip and is not read by eval/run_eval.py.
eval_match_notes: Not used: no precision or recall is computed from this fixture.
notes: Ground-truth times are offsets in seconds from clip start. Evaluator matches predicted rows by class_label/track overlap with a temporal tolerance. Overlapping tracks (e.g., gt_track_1 and gt_track_2) are distinguished by track_assoc in events and by the object overlap criterion described in eval_match_notes. The segments key has been removed because segment motion scores are not consumed by the current evaluator.
